description: Deal Desk profit check for one card the user may buy: the estimated max buy price, a suggested opening offer and, with an asking price, BUY / NEGOTIATE / PASS / NOT_ENOUGH_DATA with the estimated profit. Identify the card with search_cards before checking (use its cardId); for a slab, read the grading company and grade off the slab label in the photo. Slabs are priced from the 3 most recent sales (data color GREEN / YELLOW / RED by how recent); raw cards from the market price (GREY) and a grade-then-sell path. For a raw card, pass estimateId of the user's finished pre-grade to use its grade range. Every number is an estimate, never a guarantee; read the summary to the user. Each check is saved to the session (pass_deal marks one passed). If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

askingPrice.description: The seller's asking price in USD.

cardId.description: SlabLineage card id from search_cards (any row of the card). Give cardId or the catalog id; one of them is required.

estimateId.description: Raw cards: the user's pre-grade id (from my_pregrades).

grade.description: The grade on the slab label, e.g. "10" or "9.5". Not needed for RAW.

grader.description: The slab's grading company read off the label: PSA, TAG, CGC, BGS (Beckett), SGC, ACE or another; RAW for an ungraded card.

scrydexCardId.description: Or the card's catalog id, e.g. "sv3pt5-199" (when you have it instead of cardId).
